description: security.txt Checker (RFC 9116) — Find and validate the security.txt vulnerability-disclosure file per RFC 9116. Checks /.well-known/security.txt then /security.txt, parses Contact, Expires, Encryption, Policy, Acknowledgments, Canonical, Preferred-Languages, Hiring and CSAF, detects PGP signing, and flags missing required fields, expired or soon-expiring files, non-URI contacts, http links, wrong content-type and canonical mismatch. Verdict VALID/ISSUES/INVALID/MISSING. Param: domain (or url). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_security_txt
